status: Existing child-hook API verified as a loader; SDK retained continuation remains blocked. Parent generated-tool-guidance reload defect fixed.

liveWorkflow.fixture: Owned host/projects/sessions/runtime records, mobile Chromium, real model services, normal personal resources/logins and builtin worker with default High thinking/tools/acceptance. No custom profiles or copied credentials.
contract: A foreground worker actually reads a private value without disclosing it to its parent in the first report
It edits one module, reads it back, runs node --check and appends exactly one counted effect
The owned parent process is replaced, then the exact retained run is inspected and resumed
Resume must recall the child-only value without tools or a parent-only value, preserve all earlier audit entries and not repeat the effect
The parent must receive the automatic notice and retain both actual values after another restart
Normal skill/documentation reads remain permitted; the parent cannot read child task files

withoutHooks.sdkHaiku: Created/completed the normal foreground worker with no child checkpoint, then parent restart rejected generated tool-list reordering before resume.
withoutHooks.afterParentFixSdkHaiku: Reached actual child resume, which rejected uncheckpointed SDK history before another SDK request. SDK-3 is reproduced, not inferred only from source.

existingApiExperiment.flag: PI_PARITY_CHILD_HOOKS=1, test observer only; not enabled by the SDK provider
existingApiExperiment.api: pi-subagents/required-child-extensions, loaded from the already registered tool's public sourceInfo.path and package export
existingApiExperiment.sdkExtension: The already loaded SDK extension, discovered through its command's public source metadata
existingApiExperiment.sdkHaikuResume: Blocked by the configuration guard after background resume changes preamble and adds ponytail; tools remain identical. No instruction was dropped or fingerprint bypassed.
existingApiExperiment.codexPrototype: Actual child resume succeeded, but an overstrict harness assertion rejected a legitimate read of the subagents skill. The assertion now forbids only child task-file access.
existingApiExperiment.conclusion: The existing API can load child-owned provider hooks and save a checkpoint without changing pi-subagents. This does not prove that all production policies can safely use its parent-wide, single-registration contract, or that SDK continuation succeeds.

parentGuidanceReloadFix.finding: Parent tool declarations and every non-tool section matched after restart, but generated tool guidance had the same lines in a different order. The old handoff required declarations to differ and rejected this legitimate regeneration.

setupFailureRetained.finding: Custom fixture tools had no rendered snippets, so no generated ordering change existed. The fixture now uses Pi's public prompt-options API to render and reorder those tool snippets.

parentGuidanceReloadFix.implementation: Reuse the existing fresh-context tool handoff for order-only regeneration when declarations and the exact multiset of generated guidance lines match, the old configuration reconstructs exactly and all non-tool instructions match. No new prompt-content or general-configuration handoff is enabled.
parentGuidanceReloadFix.positive: reorder changes generated guidance with identical declarations and executes the seed effect once
parentGuidanceReloadFix.negative: reorder-override, reorder-override-drop and reorder-content reject changed/removed operator text or changed generated content before another SDK request
parentGuidanceReloadFix.liveProgressProof: After this fix, XzOSAP reaches the child guard and CyV5yt reaches the changed-child-prompt guard instead of failing at parent restart. The final order-only implementation repeats that result in W4KhkT with a saved child checkpoint. These are not successful SDK continuations.
